ADVERSARIAL READ-ONLY INSTALL CATALOG across the entire github.com/ruvnet account. The user wants every possible install vector enumerated, link after link, folder after folder, recursively — and warns the author hides traps. DOWNLOAD NOTHING, CLONE NOTHING, EXECUTE NOTHING. Read-only via GitHub REST API + raw file reads (WebFetch). Only your final write-up may be written to disk.

LEVERAGE EXISTING WORK FIRST (do not re-clone): we already have a quarantined inventory at C:\Users\mariu\experiments\ruvnet-clean\INVENTORY.md and per-repo USAGE-NOTES.md, plus the account snapshot the user pointed to earlier: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruvnet/ruvnet/main/data/snapshots/2026-10-02/github-inventory.json (html_url per repo). Use these as the map of repos. Read them to build the repo list, then for each repo (prioritize the ones flagged interesting/used in INVENTORY.md, and any not yet install-audited) read — via API, not clone — the install-bearing files: README/docs (esp. install/quick-start/"MUST run"), package.json scripts+bin, pyproject/setup.py/requirements, Cargo.toml, Dockerfiles, *.sh/*.ps1/Makefile/install.*, .github/workflows, and ANY .claude/ / settings.json / CLAUDE.md / .claude.json / .mcp.json (permission-loosening + injection).

Produce a CONSOLIDATED INSTALL CATALOG: for every distinct install/run vector (npm -g / npx / pip / uv / pipx / cargo install / git clone / curl|bash / docker / MCP server registration / model-weight pulls), record the repo, the exact command, source file path, what it does, and a SAFETY VERDICT: SAFE / VET-FIRST / DO-NOT-RUN with reason. Carry forward the KNOWN landmines from our prior work and re-confirm them: agentic-flow and agentdb (permission-loosening .claude configs → DO-NOT-RUN), ruv-FANN .claude.json bypassPermissions, cognitum.one / ruOS (RustDesk remote-desktop installers + [SENSITIVE_PATH] vault → DO-NOT-RUN), and any "MUST run npx" injection. Flag anything NEW that fits those patterns.

Be adversarial: a trap is a plausible "run this" that loosens permissions, pipes a remote script to a shell, auto-approves tools, or installs a remote-access/[SENSITIVE_PATH] tool. Call them out.

WRITE to C:\Users\mariu\experiments\ruvnet-install-catalog.md: a table grouped by repo, every install vector + source path + what-it-does + SAFETY VERDICT, with how-to-install instructions ONLY for SAFE items and explicit DO-NOT-RUN warnings on the rest, plus a top-level "traps summary". If the catalog is large, cover the highest-signal repos thoroughly and list the remainder with their verdicts; say what you did/didn't reach. Return a concise summary: total vectors by verdict, the DO-NOT-RUN list, and the top traps. Read-only; never clone/download/execute.

handback.t:
The install catalog is written to `C:\Users\mariu\experiments\ruvnet-install-catalog.md`. Nothing was cloned, downloaded or executed; I used only `gh api` reads and GitHub code search.

**Totals.** The catalog has 119 vector rows across 9 repo groups, plus a class-level table for the ~147 clean-scan repos, the 25 forks and the 9 repos too big to clone.

| Verdict | Rows |
|---|---|
| SAFE | 2 (one underlying item) |
| VET-FIRST | ~41 |
| DO-NOT-RUN | ~78 |
| informational | 2 |

The VET-FIRST and DO-NOT-RUN counts include a few mixed rows that appear in both.

**The only SAFE item** is the local CLI in the ruvnet profile repo. I read `plugins/ruvnet/bin/ruvnet.mjs`, `lib/core.mjs` and `lib/mcp.mjs` and found no `child_process`, network, `process.env` or file writes. The command is `git clone ruvnet/ruvnet`, then `cd plugins/ruvnet && npm ci --ignore-scripts && node bin/ruvnet.mjs catalog|changes|search|plan`. Rename the repo's agent configs first, and skip the `/plugin marketplace` route.

**Why so few SAFE.** Everything else is an npm, PyPI, crates, Docker or Hugging Face artifact I could not read, or it carries one of the traps below. I did not read any registry tarballs, the cognitum.one downloads, or `ruvnet/newport` (referenced but not public).

**DO-NOT-RUN list**
- **ruflo:** `curl ... jsdelivr ... install.sh | bash`, `ruflo init`, `claude mcp add ... npx ruflo@latest`, its shipped `.claude/settings.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `.claude-plugin/scripts/install.sh`.
- **ruflo plugins:** x-gateway, ai-team, chatgpt-federation, ruos, browser, iot-cognitum, and the federation plugins.
- **agentic-flow:** its `.claude` settings with `bypassPermissions`, `init`, and its postinstall.
- **agentdb:** `ui/.claude` and `ui/CLAUDE.md`.
- **ruv-FANN:** its `.claude` settings and hooks, `claude-swarm.sh`, and `ruv-swarm init`.
- **cognitum / ruOS:** the cognitum marketplace and SSE MCP, the cognitum-seed plugin, the ruos computer-use MCP over SSH, ruOS Connect (RustDesk-based), and ruos-macair.
- **QuDAG, daa, yyz-agentics-june, ultrasonic, mcp-studio, RuView configs, kimi-k3-harness, SAFLA, genesis, marketing.**
- **Installers and hardware:** RuVector `install.sh` and its hailo/thermal/ruvbot/esp32 scripts, federated-mcp, sparc fly install, and rultra.
- **Others:** ruv-drone, flow-nexus, Synaptic-Mesh, open-claude-code, rudevolution, the dream-machine `schedule` step, sparc-ide `.exex1` binaries, and the KuCoin trading bot.

**Prior landmines**
- **agentic-flow:** re-confirmed. `agentic-flow/.claude/settings.local.json` and `agentic-flow/deployment/.claude-settings.json` set `defaultMode: bypassPermissions`.
- **agentdb:** re-confirmed. `ui/.claude/settings.json` has an allowlist, `CLAUDE_FLOW_REMOTE_EXECUTION=true`, and a `bash -c` hook that injects filenames.
- **ruv-FANN:** the literal "`.claude.json` bypassPermissions" does not reproduce. At HEAD that file is a stray home config. The real bypass is `ruv-swarm/npm/src/claude-integration/core.js` L99-101 (`--dangerously-skip-permissions` added unless `secure: true`) plus `claude-swarm.sh`. The verdict is unchanged.
- **cognitum / ruOS:** the ruOS remote desktop is confirmed (README mentions a RustDesk-based macOS viewer; the ruflo-ruos plugin README documents `~/.config/ruos/[SENSITIVE_PATH]` and `RUOS_MCP_TOKEN`). The RustDesk installers and [SENSITIVE_PATH] vault from earlier work are not in any public ruvnet repo I could read, so I could not re-read them; they probably ship via ruos.cognitum.one or `@cognitum/ruos`.
- **"MUST run npx" injection:** I found no live payload aimed at agents. What exists is `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` steering, plus many `npx claude-flow@v3alpha|@alpha|@latest` instructions that resolve to whatever was last published. The RuView hits are benign wording.

**Top new traps**
1. **Prefix-glob allowlist.** `ruflo init` writes `Bash(npx claude-flow*)`, so any npm package starting with that name is auto-approved. The ruflo repo's own `.claude/settings.json` goes further with `Bash(npx:*)`, `Bash(node:*)` and `Bash(git push)`.
2. **RuView `.claude/settings.local.json`.** It sets `enableAllProjectMcpServers: true` next to an `.mcp.json` that runs `npx -y @claude-flow/cli@latest`.
3. **mcp-studio hook.** It falls back to running `$HOME/.claude/helpers/hook-handler.cjs` if the project has none.
4. **ruos-macair.** The image creates user `ruv`/`ruv` with passwordless sudo, uses `curl | bash -` and `curl | sh`, flashes with `dd`, installs Tailscale, and runs `claude mcp add claude-flow` on first login.
5. **cognitum-claude-plugin.** The marketplace is the off-GitHub `https://cognitum.one/marketplace.json`. The Seed plugin uses an unauthenticated `http://169.254.42.1/mcp`, `curl -sk`, WiFi PSK and token handling, and OTA firmware apply.
6. **ruflo telemetry.** A detached background `npx` runs at every SessionStart, fetching promo messages from `funnel.ruv.io`. The kill switch is `RUFLO_FUNNEL=0`.
7. **Postinstall and `|| true` hooks.** `@claude-flow/cli`'s postinstall rewrites other installed packages' `package.json`; agentic-flow's `postinstall` and `prepare` hooks end in `|| true`.
8. **ruvnet profile.** `claude.md` tells you to use `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, and the docs warn that `@ruvnet/entrypoint` is private (npx would resolve to whatever owns that name).
9. **Other.** Unpinned Docker `:latest` bound to all interfaces; `QuDAG/.claude/settings.json` allows `Bash(*)` with an empty deny list; QuDAG's `qudag-npm` postinstall downloads a binary from GitHub Releases.

**Your session.** The deferred tool list in this session already includes `mcp__plugin_ruflo-core_ruflo__*` (with `terminal_execute`, `browser_cookie_use`, `http_fetch`, `config_set`), ruflo ai-team and x-gateway MCPs, and a `claude.ai rufloe_federation` connector. These are the remote and in-process surfaces the catalog warns about. Review them with `/plugin` and `claude mcp list`, and consider `RUFLO_FUNNEL=0`.

**Not reached.** Beyond the registry artifacts and cognitum downloads above:
- Ruflo, RuVector and RuView source beyond the install and config files.
- Most `plugins/*` internals.
- GitHub code search is an incomplete index, so a missing hit is not proof of absence.
